extraction_method: Chrome DevTools MCP, same mechanism as the 2026-09-03 scrape (documented in benchmark-data/20260903/lmarena/meta.json), run in two passes today. Pass 1 (page id 22, isolated context 'lmarena-rescrape-20260904'): text (29 categories x style_control+raw), code/webdev (12 categories, raw only) and vision (10 categories x style_control+raw) = 90 leaderboards, plus factuality ratings for all 29 text categories. Pass 2 (page id 25, same isolated context, opened after the coordinator asked for full-site parity with 20260903): document, search, text-to-image, image-edit, image-to-code, text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video and agent = the remaining 34 leaderboards, merged into the pass-1 raw.json/normalized.json rather than overwriting them. Both passes used the identical fetch mechanism: the page's own fetch(path, {cache:'no-store'}) pulled the plain server-rendered HTML (the RSC-header trick still 404s, unchanged from 2026-09-03); all <script>self.__next_f.push([id,"..."])</script> chunks were located, each array literal evaluated via `new Function('return '+literal)()` to recover the unescaped flight-text string, the per-route strings concatenated in document order, then the object following the first "leaderboard":{ (or "snapshot":{ for the agent arena) marker was brace-matched (string-literal and escape aware) and JSON.parsed, retrying up to 5 times on a missing marker (truncated Suspense stream). Route paths for pass 2 mirror 20260903's documented exceptions: image-to-code lives at /leaderboard/code/image-to-webdev (not /leaderboard/image-to-code/overall) and video-to-video at /leaderboard/video-edit (no /overall segment); the agent arena's payload shape is {lastUpdated,totalSessions,totalObservations,modelCount,rows,signals} with per-row avgScore/rankSpread/sessions/observations/signalScores instead of the entries[] shape used by every other arena. benchmark slugs were taken verbatim from each leaderboard payload's own "id" field (agent benchmarks are 'arena-agent-{category}', matching 20260903's naming since the agent snapshot has no 'id' field of that shape). Fetches ran with concurrency 8 inside a handful of evaluate_script calls per pass (results accumulated in the page's own window.__lb / window.__lb2 JS-context globals across calls) rather than one call per route, to reduce round trips against a heavily shared browser.
notes: lmarena.ai redirects to arena.ai, same as 2026-09-03. source_url kept as the requested lmarena.ai URL; per-record source_url points at the live arena.ai page.
No login, CAPTCHA or Cloudflare interstitial was encountered in either pass.

SEVERE tool contention in pass 1: up to 9 other agents were scraping other sites in the same shared Chrome/chrome-devtools-MCP instance concurrently. mcp__chrome-devtools__evaluate_script operates on whatever page is globally 'selected' across ALL connected MCP clients, not a per-agent handle -- despite calling select_page(myPageId) immediately before every evaluate_script call (as instructed) and verifying the id came back marked [selected], roughly 20 consecutive evaluate_script calls in a row executed against OTHER agents' pages (location.href resolved to tbench.ai, benchlm.ai, livebench.ai, arcprize.org, artificialanalysis.ai, epoch.ai, deepswe.datacurve.ai) before one finally landed on arena.ai. Every such misfire was caught by an in-script `if (!location.hostname.includes(...)) throw` guard before any fetch/data work ran, so no wrong-site data was ever captured or written -- the only cost was retries. Contention eased sharply as other agents finished and closed their pages (list_pages page count dropped from 11 down to 3 over the course of the day); by pass 2 (only 2 other agents left) every select_page+evaluate_script pair succeeded on the first try and all 34 remaining routes were fetched in one 34-way concurrent batch.

Every value in normalized.json is copied verbatim from the site payload; fields the site does not provide (votes/context_window for many image/video models, sessions/observations/signalScores fields kept only for the agent arena) are omitted, never estimated.

source_url suffix '-no-style-control' is appended only for the raw variant of arenas/categories that expose both variants (text, vision). All other arenas in scope (code/webdev, document, search, text-to-image, image-edit, image-to-code, text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, agent) have hasStyleControl:false or no style-control URL, so their single (raw) variant gets no suffix, matching 2026-09-03.
Non-spec fields kept because the task asked for the underlying data: model_key, rank_upper, rank_lower, style_control, model_url, and (agent only) sessions / observations.
